hyperedges.label: Capas de verificación de la marcación QR
Pre-nómina reproducible con parámetros legales versionados

nodes.label: 20261029020000_block_truncate
nodes.rationale: Fix after tests found TRUNCATE could empty insert-only tables.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL (transaction pooler 6543)
nodes.rationale: Transaction pooler for serverless functions; session pooler (5432) required for migrations.

nodes.label: Supabase (PostgreSQL 17, us-east-1)
nodes.rationale: Same region Vercel uses by default; Nexora does not use Supabase REST API nor anon key, connects directly to PostgreSQL from the server.

nodes.label: Claves foráneas compuestas (id, company_id)
nodes.rationale: DB rejects linking an employee of company A with a site of company B even if code has a bug.

nodes.label: Capa de acceso a datos (DAL)
nodes.rationale: Resolves session -> user -> company and only queries with that company_id; companyId never comes from the browser.

nodes.label: Garantías impuestas por la base de datos
nodes.norm_label: garantias impuestas por la base de datos
nodes.rationale: Critical invariants (single open session, immutable punches, manual punch needs reason/author, approved<=detected overtime, one active QR per site, case-insensitive unique email) are enforced by DB, not only code.

nodes.label: Despliegue sin dependencia de proveedor
nodes.rationale: Any platform with Node 22 and managed PostgreSQL; the app does not depend on proprietary provider services.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16
nodes.rationale: Constraints, partial indexes and triggers: critical rules are guaranteed by the DB, not only by code.

nodes.label: API pública cerrada (RLS sin políticas)
nodes.rationale: RLS on with no policies and no grants for anon/authenticated; app connects as table owner from the server so nobody else can read rows. 'RLS without policies' advisor notice is intentional.

nodes.label: Contraseña de BD nunca en código/GitHub/chat
nodes.norm_label: contrasena de bd nunca en codigo/github/chat
nodes.rationale: Secrets only in Vercel environment variables; no secrets in frontend.

nodes.label: Ley 2466 de 2025
nodes.rationale: Labor reform: night shift from 7 p.m., staggered Sunday/holiday surcharge, max weekly hours reduced to 42 h in July 2026; must be verified in primary source in fase 6, hence versioned parameters.

nodes.label: Ley 2578 de 2026 (Virgen de Chiquinquirá)
nodes.rationale: Adds Virgen de Chiquinquirá holiday; unconstitutionality claim in progress; sanction source: Ministerio del Interior.

nodes.label: Ley 51 de 1983 (festivos)
nodes.rationale: Basis for Colombian holiday calculation (Emiliani holiday shifting).

nodes.label: Fase 6: Pre-nómina
nodes.rationale: Acceptance: known cases match; missing parameters produce a warning, not a number.

nodes.label: Módulos en vista previa (Pronto)
nodes.rationale: Incomplete modules are visible with a 'Pronto' label and never show fabricated data.

nodes.label: Pruebas
nodes.rationale: Tests never touch the working DB: they create/drop their own databases whose name must end in _test.

nodes.label: Festivos colombianos calculados
nodes.rationale: Computed from law and tested against Ministerio del Interior and 2026-2027 national calendars.

nodes.label: Parámetro faltante → advertencia, no número
nodes.rationale: Calculation never invents; flags line and asks for human review.

nodes.label: Pre-nómina estimada
nodes.rationale: Always presented as an estimate, not a legal settlement; does not replace the accountant.

nodes.label: Parámetros legales versionados por fecha con fuente
nodes.norm_label: parametros legales versionados por fecha con fuente
nodes.rationale: No hard-coded percentages; laws change gradually so each value has effective date, norm and URL.

nodes.label: parameter_snapshot
nodes.rationale: Snapshot of parameters used so an October estimate is reproducible even if the law changes in December.

nodes.label: audit_log
nodes.rationale: Insert-only; UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE blocked by trigger.

nodes.label: company
nodes.rationale: Already has status, plan_code, max_employees, max_sites for SaaS readiness; billing not built yet.

nodes.label: labor_parameter
nodes.rationale: Every legal value is a row with effective date, norm and verification URL; no percentages hard-coded.

nodes.label: Regla de oro de autorización
nodes.rationale: Every Server Action and read re-verifies session and role on the server; hiding a button is not security.

nodes.label: Preparación SaaS (sin cobros)
nodes.rationale: company has status/plan_code/limits and SUPERADMIN role; subscription billing deliberately not built in this version.

nodes.label: Sesiones propias en BD + Argon2id + passkeys
nodes.norm_label: sesiones propias en bd + argon2id + passkeys
nodes.rationale: Auth.js v5 still beta and does not cover device binding; DB sessions can be revoked instantly (retired employee, lost phone).

nodes.label: Bloqueo 15 min tras 5 intentos
nodes.rationale: Generic error message and equal response time when email doesn't exist to avoid user enumeration; lockout logged in audit.

nodes.label: Turnos que cruzan medianoche (minutos > 1440)
nodes.rationale: Template uses minutes beyond 1440 (22:00-06:00 = 1320-1800); real start_at/end_at stored; split shift = two rows, rest = no row.

nodes.label: Cookie de sesión httpOnly/SameSite=Lax/__Host-/Secure
nodes.rationale: Random token in cookie, only hash in DB; employees 60 days renewable, admins 12 h; immediate revocation on deactivation, reset or company suspension.

nodes.label: Decreto 0159 de 2026
nodes.rationale: Replaces suspended Decreto 1469 de 2025 for 2026 minimum wage (SMMLV).

nodes.label: Decreto 1469 de 2025
nodes.rationale: 2026 minimum wage decree, suspended and replaced.

nodes.label: cacheComponents desactivado
nodes.rationale: Almost everything depends on user/company; dynamic rendering is simpler and removes the risk of serving another company's cached data.

nodes.label: Monolito modular en Next.js
nodes.rationale: One small team, one deploy, one DB; modules separated by folders, not services.

nodes.label: TypeScript estricto
nodes.rationale: Errors at compile time, not in production.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 + React 19 (Server Components/Actions)
nodes.rationale: Sensitive logic runs on the server, no separate public API to protect.

nodes.label: Prisma 7 (adaptador pg)
nodes.rationale: Generated types, versioned migrations; stable 7.x line because 8 is still RC.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS 4 + componentes estilo shadcn/ui
nodes.rationale: Design tokens as CSS variables: light/dark mode without duplicating components.

nodes.label: Zod 4 en cada Server Action
nodes.rationale: Never trust what the browser sends.

nodes.label: attendance_event
nodes.rationale: Immutable punch: insert-only; UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE blocked by trigger; a correction is a new event with reason and author referencing the original.

nodes.label: employee_contract
nodes.rationale: Salary and working hours versioned by date.

nodes.label: work_session
nodes.rationale: One open work session per employee enforced by a partial unique index, preventing double entry even with concurrent requests.

nodes.label: Fase 5: Gestión laboral
nodes.rationale: Acceptance: rejecting overtime does not alter recorded time.

nodes.label: Detección de horas extra (registrado − programado, umbral 15 min)
nodes.norm_label: deteccion de horas extra (registrado − programado, umbral 15 min)

nodes.label: Tres tiempos que nunca se mezclan (programado/registrado/autorizado)
nodes.norm_label: tres tiempos que nunca se mezclan (programado/registrado/autorizado)
nodes.rationale: Rejecting overtime never deletes or reduces recorded time; it only changes pre-payroll treatment. Reports show the three columns.

nodes.label: src/server/actions.ts (Server Actions)
nodes.rationale: Actions only obtain the actor and delegate; the domain functions verify permissions.

nodes.label: device_binding
nodes.rationale: Only the hash of the long-lived httpOnly device token is stored.

nodes.label: APP_URL
nodes.rationale: Must exactly match the app domain because passkeys verify origin; also used in QR links. Changing domain later forces reprinting QRs.

nodes.label: Ley 1581 de 2012 (datos personales)
nodes.rationale: Colombian personal-data law: requires recorded consent with policy version, location only at punch time, legal review of policy, privacy notice, coordinate retention and SIC registration.

nodes.label: Passkeys (WebAuthn / SimpleWebAuthn)
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint/face handled by the OS; Nexora never receives or stores biometrics. Reduces risk of lending an unlocked phone.

nodes.label: Códigos de rechazo (INVALID_QR, DEVICE_NOT_BOUND, PASSKEY_FAILED, OUTSIDE_RADIUS, DUPLICATE_PUNCH…)
nodes.norm_label: codigos de rechazo (invalid_qr, device_not_bound, passkey_failed, outside_radius, duplicate_punch...)

nodes.label: Información que se necesita de la empresa real
nodes.norm_label: informacion que se necesita de la empresa real

nodes.label: Dominio para los QR
nodes.rationale: Changing domain later forces reprinting all QRs.

nodes.label: Web responsive + PWA
nodes.rationale: Employees don't install anything from a store: scan the QR and go.

nodes.label: Vinculación de dispositivo
nodes.rationale: Long-lived httpOnly cookie (400 days), hash only in DB; first phone active, additional pending until admin approves (old one unbound). IP not used because it changes and is shared.

nodes.label: Jornada abierta > 16 h → por revisar sin hora de salida
nodes.norm_label: jornada abierta > 16 h → por revisar sin hora de salida
nodes.rationale: System never invents an exit time; new punch opens another session.

nodes.label: Verificación de ubicación (Haversine, radio + precisión)
nodes.rationale: Location requested once at punch time (getCurrentPosition, no tracking); within radius accepted, within radius+accuracy accepted for review, poor accuracy (>100 m default) or none rejected.

nodes.label: Limitaciones honestas de la marcación
nodes.rationale: Static QR can be photographed, browser GPS can be spoofed, device link can be lost, unlocked phone can be lent; hence layered controls and a 30-day pilot reviewing rejected attempts.

nodes.label: Clave de idempotencia
nodes.rationale: A double tap does not create two records; same key returns same result.

nodes.label: Piloto de 30 días con empleados reales
nodes.norm_label: piloto de 30 dias con empleados reales
nodes.rationale: Validate with real employees, review rejected punches and re-bound devices weekly before opening to other companies.

nodes.label: QR con publicCode aleatorio revocable
nodes.rationale: Random code that can be revoked and reprinted (new version); rotation invalidates old code instantly.

nodes.label: La hora la pone el servidor (timestamptz)
nodes.norm_label: la hora la pone el servidor (timestamptz)
nodes.rationale: Timestamps come from the server, never the phone; per-company timezone default America/Bogota.

nodes.label: Marcaciones demo con origen SYSTEM
nodes.rationale: Simulated punches never confused with real ones.
